label: Light duty
description: Cars and light trucks combined, the way FHWA and BTS report vehicle-miles and passenger-miles since 2007. Rates for passenger cars and light trucks roll up to this class.

label: Passenger car
description: Passenger cars, from FARS body types 1 to 13. FARS counts them separately, but exposure after 2006 exists only for light duty, so rates roll up to light duty.

label: Light truck
description: Light trucks, from FARS body types 14 to 49. FARS counts them separately, but exposure after 2006 exists only for light duty, so rates roll up to light duty.

label: Motorcycle
description: Motorcycles and similar two-wheeled motor vehicles, from FARS body types 80 to 89.

label: Bus
description: Buses of all kinds, from FARS body types 50 to 59. Buses are classed as commercial road vehicles.

label: Heavy truck
description: Medium and heavy trucks, from FARS body types 60 to 79. They are classed as commercial road vehicles.

label: Light aircraft
description: Piston and electric airplanes in NTSB data, plus Part 91 airplanes with no engine record. Some of the airplanes with no engine record may be turbine aircraft.

label: Turboprop
description: Turboprop airplanes, taken from the NTSB engine type. The FAA survey reports them as Turboprop.

label: Business jet
description: Turbofan, turbojet and geared-turbofan airplanes that are not operated under Part 121 or 129. The FAA survey reports them as Turbojet.

label: Airliner
description: Turbofan or turbojet airplanes operated under Part 121 or 129, plus Part 121 or 129 airplanes with no engine record. Part 121 cargo airplanes are included.

label: Helicopter
description: Helicopters and gyroplanes in NTSB data, and rotorcraft in the FAA survey.

label: Experimental
description: Amateur-built and other experimental-certificate aircraft. NTSB marks them by the homebuilt flag, which takes precedence over engine type, so they are not counted in other aircraft classes.

label: Other
description: Vehicles that fit no named class. On the road this is FARS body types 90 to 97; in aviation it is gliders, balloons, blimps, weight-shift, powered parachutes, ultralights, powered lift and rockets.

label: Unknown
description: Vehicles whose type is not recorded. On the road this is FARS body types 98 and 99.

label: Private
description: Operated for personal use rather than for hire. In NTSB data this is Part 91 personal or unrecorded use and non-U.S. non-commercial flights; on the road it is FARS special use 19 and vehicles with no special use.

label: Commercial
description: Operated for hire or business. On the road this is buses, heavy trucks and FARS special uses 1, 2, 3, 12 and 20 to 23; in aviation it is Parts 121, 125, 129, 133, 135 and 137, and Part 91 business-type uses such as instruction, executive and aerial work.

label: Government
description: Operated by a public body. In NTSB data this is public-use and armed-forces flights; on the road it is FARS special uses 4 to 8, 10, 11 and 24, unless a bus or heavy truck body type makes it commercial.

label: Unknown
description: Operator type not recorded or not decided by the source. In FARS this is special use 98 and 99.

label: Road private
description: Road vehicles not identified as commercial. FARS decides this from operator use: no special use, or a private special use, and a body type that is not a bus or heavy truck.

label: Road commercial
description: Road vehicles in commercial service. FARS decides this from body type (all buses and heavy trucks) or from FARS special uses 1, 2, 3, 12 and 20 to 23.

label: General aviation
description: Part 91, on-demand Part 135, Part 137 and Part 133 flying together, as the FAA General Aviation and Part 135 Activity Survey counts them. Exposure exists only at this level, so rates by finer class need it as a grouping.

label: Part 91
description: General operating and flight rules, covering private and corporate flying, including Part 91K fractional ownership. Counted within general aviation.

label: Part 121
description: Scheduled and supplemental air carrier operations with large aircraft, measured by BTS as domestic air carrier miles. Events include all-cargo flights, although the exposure is passenger-miles.

label: Part 135
description: On-demand commuter and air taxi operations, counted within general aviation. Scheduled Part 135 service is classed separately.

label: Part 135 scheduled
description: Scheduled commuter operations under Part 135, which the FAA survey does not cover, so no exposure exists for this class.

label: Part 137
description: Agricultural aircraft operations such as crop dusting. Counted within general aviation.

label: Part 133
description: Rotorcraft external-load operations. Counted within general aviation.

label: Other
description: Regulations that are not separately classed. In NTSB data this is Parts 125, 129, 103, 107 and 437, public-use and armed-forces flights, and non-U.S. flights; road events with a government special use also land here.

label: Unknown
description: Regulation not recorded. In NTSB data this is an empty or unknown regulation profile; in FARS it is special use 98 and 99.

label: None
description: No mandated maintenance or inspection. No current source mapping assigns this value.

label: State inspection
description: Periodic inspection set by individual states, as for passenger vehicles. No current source mapping assigns this value.

label: Mandated periodic
description: Federally mandated periodic maintenance or inspection. FARS assigns it to buses and heavy trucks; NTSB assigns it to Parts 91, 91K, 121, 125, 133, 135 and 137.

label: Unknown
description: Maintenance regime not determined. FARS leaves cars, light trucks, motorcycles and other body types here, and NTSB uses it for regulations without a mapped regime.

label: Aviation
description: Air transport, including airliners, general aviation and helicopters. Events come from NTSB and exposure from BTS and the FAA survey.

label: Highway
description: Road transport, including cars, trucks, buses and motorcycles. Events come from FARS and exposure from BTS.

label: Rail
description: Rail transport. No current source mapping assigns this mode.

label: Transit
description: Public transit systems. No current source mapping assigns this mode.

label: Marine
description: Waterborne transport. No current source mapping assigns this mode.

label: Pipeline
description: Pipeline transport. No current source mapping assigns this mode.
